evidence.text: "I am 100% Pro-Life. I will always staunchly defend the right to life and protect the rights of the unborn. Every life is a sacred blessing from God and must be protected."

positions.question: Do you support protecting government officials, including law enforcement officers, from personal liability in civil lawsuits concerning alleged misconduct?

evidence.text: "I am always proud to stand with and support our law enforcement heroes. As such, I will always oppose the radical left’s efforts to Defund the Police and will advocate for increased funding to support the men and women who put their lives on the line every day to protect our communities."

positions.question: Do you support increasing defense spending?

evidence.text: "Ensuring a strong national defense is core to America’s national security and it is one of the most important duties of our Congress. Through my seat on the House Armed Services Committee, I am honored to play an active role in helping to bolster our national defense and provide a powerful deterrence to the pacing threat from China. I will always work to protect and maintain our nation’s military dominance, and to support the men and women in uniform who work tirelessly to serve our great nation."
Voted in favor of HR 2670: "National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024"
Voted in favor of HR 4365: "Department of Defense Appropriations Act, 2024"

positions.question: Do you support increasing security along the southern US border?

evidence.text: "The radical left’s embrace of illegal immigration and their support for open borders has led to a massive influx of drugs and illegal activity flowing through our Southern Border. Instead of demonizing the men and women who work hard to protect us from this invasion, we must secure our border by building the border wall, increasing border security officers, and better enforcing our existing immigration laws. As your congressman, I will always advocate for border security and will fight hard to secure our borders!"
Rated 89% by NumbersUSA
Voted in favor of HR 2: "Secure the Border Act of 2023"
Voted in favor of HR 5525: "Continuing Appropriations and Border Security Enhancement Act, 2024"
